name: Terminal Synaptique
description: Nœud Prime centralisant les opérations de guerre cybernétique de l'Omni-Réseau sur tous les fronts simultanément.

subject.archetype: Terminal Synaptique — Omni-Réseau Epic class reseau

loadout.armor_outfit: Sleek cybernetic combat suit with circuit pathways throughout fabric glowing bright cyan under stress, neural temple implant sparking from combat overload, holographic shield generators deployed on forearms, clean geometric lines contrasting with digital chaos forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Neural hacking deck with holographic wrist interface mid-operation showing active code streams, EMP emitter gauntlet crackling with charge creating visible blue arcs, data-spike dagger with glowing edge The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting adjacent_enemy, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Low sweeping strike with arm extended toward adjacent enemy with powerful significant dark corruption spreading from fingertips in thick tendrils burrowing into enemy with visible weakening
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Cyber warfare zone with holographic displays shattering and glitching during battle, digital fortifications crumbling under enemy ICE attacks with visible code deterioration, server towers toppling and sparking, electric storms rippling through infrastructure
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick corruption tendrils spreading across ground connecting to enemy with visible strength drain as debuff takes hold, enemy visibly dimming and wilting, Ground between positions withering as corruption spreads, visible weakening wave passing through adjacent enemy as armor dulls and weapons dim, Data streams arcing between floating terminals like electric whip lashes, holographic shields shattering into cascading pixel fragments dissolving mid-air, EMP waves visible as expanding blue rings distorting everything, server racks exploding in showers of sparks and circuit boards, electric arcs grounding through coolant puddles creating branching lightning
